title: Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital Saket inaugurates 400-bed tower
summary: Expansion takes Max Saket’s total capacity to approximately 1,200 beds across 22+ specialties

contentHtml:
Expansion takes Max Saket’s total capacity to approximately 1,200 beds across 22+ specialties

Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, has inaugurated a new 400-bed tower as part of its expansion of tertiary and quaternary healthcare capacity in the National Capital Region. The tower was inaugurated by Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Amit Shah.

The event was attended by Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta as Guest of Honour. Minister for Health & Family Welfare, Transport and Information Technology, Delhi Government, Dr Pankaj Kumar Singh, and Member of Parliament, South Delhi, Ramvir Singh Bidhuri, also attended the event.

With the expansion, Max Hospital, Saket will have a total capacity of approximately 1,200 beds, making it the largest private hospital in Delhi by bed capacity. The hospital provides tertiary and quaternary healthcare across 22+ specialties.

Max Saket is part of Max Healthcare’s integrated healthcare and medical education ecosystem, backed by 42,000+ employees. Max Healthcare provided free treatment worth ₹244 crore to 3.60 lakh patients last year. Through the Max Institute of Medical Sciences, the organisation has supported 1.62 lakh students to date through higher education, training and professional learning programmes.

In the last financial year, Max Healthcare treated over 40 lakh patients from 800+ cities and 180+ countries, including those seeking specialised and advanced medical care.

Commenting on the inauguration, Abhay Soi, Chairman and Managing Director, Max Healthcare Institute Limited, said; “This state-of-the-art new facility brings together cutting-edge technology, world-class infrastructure and exceptional Indian clinical talent to deliver advanced, high-quality patient care to people from India and across the globe. It also contributes to the broader vision of building a stronger and inclusive healthcare ecosystem in India and supporting the nation’s journey towards a Viksit Bharat.”

The new facility is equipped with medical technologies including the Da Vinci Xi Surgical Robot and Mako Total Knee Replacement Robot, supporting minimally invasive procedures across specialties.

With the expansion, Max Healthcare is strengthening its healthcare infrastructure in Delhi-NCR, with a focus on clinical care, access to specialised treatment and an integrated ecosystem for specialised medical care for people from India and across the globe.
